license_required.quote: Every act or practice falling within the practice of medicine and surgery as defined in section 38-2024 and not specially excepted in this section shall constitute the practice of medicine and surgery and may be performed in this state only by those licensed by law to practice medicine in Nebraska.

umbrella_agency.quote: The State Board of Health shall appoint members to the boards designated in section 38-167

degree_required.value: Graduate of an accredited school or college of medicine
degree_required.quote: Present proof that he or she is a graduate of an accredited school or college of medicine

required.quote: Present proof that he or she has served at least one year of graduate medical education approved by the board or, if a foreign medical graduate, present proof that he or she has served at least two years of graduate medical education approved by the board

duration.value: at least one year for domestic graduates; at least two years for foreign medical graduates
duration.quote: at least one year of graduate medical education approved by the board or, if a foreign medical graduate, present proof that he or she has served at least two years of graduate medical education approved by the board

kind.quote: graduate medical education approved by the board

exams.name: Licensing examination approved by the board
exams.quote: Pass a licensing examination approved by the board covering appropriate medical subjects

required.quote: Beginning with the first license renewal period which begins on or after October 1, 2018, the continuing competency requirements for a nurse midwife, dentist, physician, physician assistant, nurse practitioner, podiatrist, and veterinarian who prescribes controlled substances shall include at least three hours of continuing education biennially regarding prescribing opiates

hours_per_period.quote: at least three hours of continuing education biennially regarding prescribing opiates

period_years.quote: at least three hours of continuing education biennially

topical_requirements.quote: The continuing education may include, but is not limited to, education regarding prescribing and administering opiates, the risks and indicators regarding development of addiction to opiates, and emergency opiate situations. One-half hour of the three hours of continuing education shall cover the prescription drug monitoring program

available.quote: Physicians who are licensed in good standing to practice medicine under the laws of another state when incidentally called into this state or contacted via electronic or other medium for consultation with a physician licensed in this state

requirements.value: Licensed in good standing in another state; consultation only or temporary hospital privileges; cannot maintain regular office in Nebraska
requirements.quote: Physicians who are licensed in good standing to practice medicine under the laws of another state when incidentally called into this state or contacted via electronic or other medium for consultation with a physician licensed in this state. For purposes of this subdivision, consultation means evaluating the medical data of the patient as provided by the treating physician and rendering a recommendation to such treating physician as to the method of treatment or analysis of the data. The interpretation of a radiological image by a physician who specializes in radiology is not a consultation

regulatory_model.quote: Every act or practice falling within the practice of medicine and surgery as defined in section 38-2024 and not specially excepted in this section shall constitute the practice of medicine and surgery and may be performed in this state only by those licensed by law to practice medicine in Nebraska.

credential_type.quote: License means an authorization issued by the department to an individual to engage in a profession or to a business to provide services which would otherwise be unlawful in this state in the absence of such authorization.

is_mandatory.quote: Every act or practice falling within the practice of medicine and surgery as defined in section 38-2024 and not specially excepted in this section shall constitute the practice of medicine and surgery and may be performed in this state only by those licensed by law to practice medicine in Nebraska.

title_protection.quote: Persons who attach to their name the title of M.D., surgeon, physician, physician and surgeon, or any word or abbreviation and who indicate that they are engaged in the treatment or diagnosis of ailments, diseases, injuries, pain, deformity, infirmity, or any physical or mental condition of human beings

scope_protection.quote: Persons who prescribe and furnish medicine for some illness, disease, ailment, injury, pain, deformity, or any physical or mental condition, or treat the same by surgery

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or deception in obtaining a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: fraud or deception in obtaining a license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unprofessional conduct as defined by statute or board rules
Incompetency in the practice of the profession
Gross negligence in the practice of the profession
Violation of any law relating to the practice of the profession
disciplinary_grounds.quote: violation of any law relating to the practice of the profession

definition_quote.value: Persons who publicly profess to be physicians or surgeons or publicly profess to assume the duties incident to the practice of medicine, surgery, or any of their branches; Persons who prescribe and furnish medicine for some illness, disease, ailment, injury, pain, deformity, or any physical or mental condition, or treat the same by surgery; Persons holding themselves out to the public as being qualified in the diagnosis or treatment of diseases, ailments, pain, deformity, or any physical or mental condition, or injuries of human beings
definition_quote.quote: Persons who publicly profess to be physicians or surgeons or publicly profess to assume the duties incident to the practice of medicine, surgery, or any of their branches; Persons who prescribe and furnish medicine for some illness, disease, ailment, injury, pain, deformity, or any physical or mental condition, or treat the same by surgery; Persons holding themselves out to the public as being qualified in the diagnosis or treatment of diseases, ailments, pain, deformity, or any physical or mental condition, or injuries of human beings

methods_authorized.quote: practice of medicine, surgery, or any of their branches

drug_authority.value: Prescribe and furnish medicine for illness, disease, ailment, injury, pain, deformity, or any physical or mental condition
drug_authority.quote: Persons who prescribe and furnish medicine for some illness, disease, ailment, injury, pain, deformity, or any physical or mental condition

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates must provide a permanent certificate from the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG) or credentials certifying passage of the Visa Qualifying Examination, or credentials certifying completion of the Fifth Pathway program and ECFMG examination. Foreign medical graduates must complete at least two years of graduate medical education approved by the board.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: if a foreign medical graduate, provide a copy of a permanent certificate issued by the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates that is currently effective and relates to such applicant or provide such credentials as are necessary to certify that such foreign medical graduate has successfully passed the Visa Qualifying Examination or its successor or equivalent examination required by the United States Department of Health and Human Services and the United States Citizenship and Immigration Services, or (c) if a graduate of a foreign medical school who has successfully completed a program of American medical training designated as the Fifth Pathway and who additionally has successfully passed the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates examination but has not yet received the permanent certificate attesting to the same, provide such credentials as certify the same to the Division of Public Health of the Department of Health and Human Services

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: Present proof that he or she has served at least one year of graduate medical education approved by the board

pain_management_education_required.quote: Beginning with the first license renewal period which begins on or after October 1, 2018, the continuing competency requirements for a nurse midwife, dentist, physician, physician assistant, nurse practitioner, podiatrist, and veterinarian who prescribes controlled substances shall include at least three hours of continuing education biennially regarding prescribing opiates

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: One-half hour of the three hours of continuing education shall cover the prescription drug monitoring program described in sections 71-2454 to 71-2456.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: Physicians licensed in another state may be contacted via electronic or other medium for consultation with a physician licensed in Nebraska. Consultation means evaluating medical data and rendering recommendations, but does not include radiological image interpretation.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: Physicians who are licensed in good standing to practice medicine under the laws of another state when incidentally called into this state or contacted via electronic or other medium for consultation with a physician licensed in this state. For purposes of this subdivision, consultation means evaluating the medical data of the patient as provided by the treating physician and rendering a recommendation to such treating physician as to the method of treatment or analysis of the data.

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: The clerk of any county or district court in this state shall report to the department the conviction of any person credentialed by the department under the Uniform Credentialing Act of any felony or of any misdemeanor involving the use, sale, distribution, administration, or dispensing of a controlled substance, alcohol or chemical impairment, or substance abuse and shall also report a judgment against any such credential holder arising out of a claim of professional liability.

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: The department may contract to provide a Licensee Assistance Program to credential holders regulated by the department. The program shall be limited to providing education, referral assistance, and monitoring of compliance with treatment for abuse of, dependence on, or active addiction to alcohol, any controlled substance, or any mind-altering substance

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: Require the applicant to submit to a complete diagnostic examination at the expense of the applicant by one or more physicians or other qualified professionals appointed by the board
